newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in thin trading on Thursday, dealers said.
They said volume was small but overall sentiment seemed to indicate further strengthening of the rupiah, with offshore operators seen sustaining dollar unloading.
Swap rates were stable after sharp declines in the past few days. Some dealers said they had bottomed out.
But one local bank dealer said he doubted they would stage a strong upturn because offshore operators seemed to have covered most of their open positions.
"We may see operators forming new positions next week as swap rates remain relatively cheap," the dealer said.
One Japanese bank dealer said earlier some operators appeared to have started revising previous positions as they realised swaps were oversold and dollar supply was improving.
The dealer said swap rates were cheap and spot rupiah was too low, which had previously led operators to sell forward.
"But now operators realise that swaps are oversold. With an easing of the dollar supply and a stabilised liquidity condition, the market is looking for a new equilibrium," he said.
Overnight dollar deposit rates eased to around six percent from nine percent on Wednesday. Overnight money was last traded at 6.5 percent, relatively stable from the morning level.
Tom/next swaps rebounded strongly to 0.7 points after being sold at par levels at the opening. Dealers said many operators might have missed longer dates.
Tom/next will be due on Tuesday because of a public holiday in the United States on Monday.
Spot rupiah was at 2,373.75/74.50 at 0900 GMT against an opening of 2,378.0/79.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,375.25/75.75 and 2,377.5/78.0, respectively.
One-month swaps were at 9.75/10.5, two at 21.0/22.00, three at 31.00/33.50 and six at 71.0/72.5 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,366/2,558 and the conversion band at 2,366/2,414 on Thursday after depreciating the rupiah by three points in the past three days.
